name: rosetta-string-length-03-grapheme-length
code:
use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Globalization.StringInfo

let subjects = ["møøse", "𝔘𝔫𝔦𝔠𝔬𝔡𝔢", "J̲o̲s̲é̲"]

for subject in subjects do
    let graphemes = StringInfo(subject)

    write_line("{subject}: {graphemes.length_in_text_elements} graphemes")
od
fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Globalization.StringInfo

let subjects = ["møøse", "𝔘𝔫𝔦𝔠𝔬𝔡𝔢", "J̲o̲s̲é̲"]

for subject in subjects do
    let graphemes = StringInfo(subject)

    write_line("{subject}: {graphemes.length_in_text_elements} graphemes")
od
output:
møøse: 5 graphemes
𝔘𝔫𝔦𝔠𝔬𝔡𝔢: 7 graphemes
J̲o̲s̲é̲: 4 graphemes
